item: An unreadable imported-events store is kept as calendar_feed_imports.json.damaged before the next save replaces it (R397 b, item 31)
summary: _load_json marks the imports store (by path) when it exists but reads as empty: torn JSON, an I/O error, a cut character, or JSON that parses to nothing usable; _save_json then moves it to <name>.damaged just before os.replace, once, never overwriting an earlier copy; a healthy read clears the mark; the three rebuilt stores are replaced as before; log lines carry names and the exception class only.
